newsitem.title: SWEDEN: NCC says in final talks for Polish order.
newsitem.headline: NCC says in final talks for Polish order.

text.p: Construction group NCC said on Thursday that it was in final negotiations for a contract in Poland worth three billion crowns.
NCC said in a statement that it was part of an international consortium, Autostrade Wielkopolska SA, that was negotiating with the Polish traffic ministry to build a motorway in Poland.
The project would include 360 kms of highway between Swiecko and Lodz and is the first part of a motorway between Berlin and Moscow.
"The consortium has got a concession to build and operate the morotway and now is starting negotiations about a concession agreement and financing," NCC said in a statement.
The project was expected to start this year.
The total project would cost about 20-25 billion crowns and take 10 years to complete.
NCC said its share of the project would be worth about three billion crowns.
The project would be divided into three stages; building the road from Swiecko at the German border to Poznan, the road from Poznan to Konin and finally building a road from Konin to Lodz.
The consortium also includes Polish companies and several leading European building companies, NCC said.
